mood: Editorial + moody with pops of color. Brooklyn art zine meets high-end gallery.

headings.usage: H1, H2, large expressive quotes, brand wordmarks. Never use for small UI elements.

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, navigation, dashboard data.

colors.rules: Deep black backgrounds. Magenta/pink/blue/yellow accents used sparingly and boldly. Avoid AI-slop purple gradients on white. Never use pure #000000.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
layouts.grids: Mode A (Tetris Grid/Masonry) for marketing/gallery pages to emphasize editorial feel. Mode B (High Density) for dashboards.
layouts.alignment: Strong asymmetric layouts. Avoid center-everything disease. Left-align text blocks, offset images.
layouts.hero: Max overlay opacity bg-black/50 for hero images to keep artwork visible.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #27272A (zinc-800) for subtle separation. Grid borders for technical dashboard look.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle grain texture overlay on dark backgrounds. High-end glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) for sticky headers ONLY.
visual_enhancers.images: Art-first hierarchy. Images should be massive, unconstrained by standard e-commerce boxes.

components.marketing_pages: Custom HTML/Tailwind for Home, Gallery, Portfolios. Staggered masonry grids. Editorial typography.
components.dashboards: Shadcn components heavily customized for a brutalist dark mode look. Flat solid surfaces instead of glass.
components.buttons: Sharp rectangular edges or subtle pill-shaped. High contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-black). Accents used for primary CTAs.
components.navigation: Sticky header with backdrop-blur. Custom 'Monster' wordmark in bold Gloock. Links visible on desktop, no transparent backgrounds without blur.

motion.transitions: Smooth micro-interactions. Hover states on all interactive elements. DO NOT use generic `transition-all`.
motion.animations: Subtle parallax on scroll. Staggered fade-ins for gallery items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for standard text. Text over images must have gradient or shadow.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings with accent colors (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-magenta).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a hybrid fullstack UI merging an editorial art gallery aesthetic with e-commerce features (House of Monster).
Apply 'Gloock' for oversized serif headings and 'Outfit' for clean body copy. Inject both using Tailwind config or standard CSS imports.
Enforce a dark theme primarily (#050505 or #0a0a0c) avoiding completely black (#000000) or 'AI-slop purple'.
Use asymmetric bento/masonry grid structures. Stop centering everything.
Create a standout 'Founder Story' section highlighting the founder 'Monster', Brooklyn roots, and two cats. Use provided imagery.
Implement Shadcn UI for the Cart, Stripe checkout, Artist Upload Dashboard, and Admin Commission Config. Strip 'Vercel-look' defaults in favor of brutalist dark mode styles.
Introduce splashes of bold color (magenta, pink, yellow, blue) on key accents, badges, or 'Art of the Week' spotlight highlights.
Ensure the 'Monster' custom wordmark leverages the Gloock font.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds under headers/overlays; use backdrop-blur glassmorphism.
Use .js file extensions, not .tsx where applicable.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
